faqs.question: How does delivery work?
faqs.answer: Each shop fulfils its own part of your basket. Choose home delivery or store pickup per shop at checkout. Delivery fees, minimum order values and estimated times are set by each seller and shown before you pay.

faqs.question: Can I order from more than one shop?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your basket is grouped by shop and becomes one parent order with a separate order for each shop. Sellers only ever see their own items and only ever receive their own share of the payment.

faqs.question: How do I know my order is nearby?
faqs.answer: Open Orders → your order. Once a seller accepts and prepares it, the status timeline updates as the order is picked up and sent out for delivery. If a NearBuy runner is assigned, their name and status appear on the order page.

faqs.question: What is the delivery OTP for?
faqs.answer: For home delivery, the runner must enter the 6-digit code shown on your order page before the order can be marked delivered. Never share the code before you have the items.

faqs.question: How does store pickup work?
faqs.answer: Choose Store pickup at checkout for a shop that offers it. You will get a collection code on your order page. Show it at the counter; the shop marks the order complete once it is handed over.

faqs.question: Which payment methods can I use?
faqs.answer: Cash on delivery and pay at store work today. UPI, cards, net banking and wallets are enabled as soon as a payment gateway is configured for the deployment — the checkout says clearly when online payment is unavailable.

faqs.question: When will I get my refund?
faqs.answer: Cancelled and approved return amounts are refunded to the original payment method. Cash-on-delivery refunds are recorded for a bank transfer or store credit arranged by the shop. A refund is only marked completed after the payment provider confirms it.

faqs.question: Can I cancel after ordering?
faqs.answer: Yes, until the seller starts preparing the order. After that, contact support or request a return once the order is delivered. The cancel button on the order page only appears when cancellation is still possible.

faqs.question: What can I return?
faqs.answer: Perishables such as milk, eggs and cut fruit are not returnable unless they arrive damaged. Packaged goods, stationery and household items can be returned within the return window shown on the product page.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to browse?
faqs.answer: No. You can browse shops, products and offers without signing in. An account is needed to save a wishlist, write reviews, or place and track an order.

faqs.question: How do I change my mobile number?
faqs.answer: Open My Account → Profile. The new number must be verified with a one-time code before it replaces the old one.

faqs.question: How do I raise a complaint?
faqs.answer: Open Help & Support, choose a category, and add your order number if relevant. You will get a ticket reference and can follow every reply in Help → My tickets.
